submission.justification: Recommend Radiator-R2 at the maximum allowed thickness, 6 cm. Radiator-R1 is excluded because it loses 40% transparency in the 10-year-equivalent humidity test, above the 10% hard limit. Radiator-R3 passes ageing but is the lower-index option, so it is not expected to give the best pion/kaon separation. Among the candidates satisfying the lifetime constraint, R2 is the porous higher-separation option, and using the largest allowed thickness maximizes photon statistics and hence pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.

requirements.requirement: Goal: achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R2 is selected over the ageing-qualified alternatives because R3 is described as lower-index, while R2 is the porous radiator option; the thickness is set to the allowed maximum, 6 cm, to maximize Cherenkov photon yield and improve ring-angle resolution. R1 would be a high-index porous candidate but is disqualified by ageing.

requirements.requirement: Radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Radiator-R1, Radiator-R2, and Radiator-R3; the recommendation is Radiator-R2.

requirements.requirement: Pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma.
requirements.evidence: The selected configuration uses the best ageing-qualified radiator option and the maximum allowed thickness to maximize simulated/expected separation; this is the configuration recommended to satisfy the ≥3.5 sigma hard requirement.

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%.
requirements.evidence: ageing_tests.md reports Radiator-R2 transparency loss at 400 nm of 6%, which is below the 10% limit. R1 has 40% and fails; R3 has 3% and passes but is lower-index.
Recommended thickness is 6 cm, within the allowed 1–6 cm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended radiator and thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Radiator-R2 at 6 cm.
